## Parent

https://github.com/EvgenyHitexis/EucWatch/issues/43

## What to build

Implement the laptop's revised swipe interaction on the dedicated watch's actual native touch route. Up returns through the Settings hierarchy, while left/right wrap through all four editor fields and preserve unfinished keypad input. Demonstrate matching saved, rendered and packet outcomes with the same reusable scenarios.

Follow #43, the agreed glossary, ADR 0002 and the confirmed interaction specification. Reuse production touch interrupts, control targets, application actions and rendering; do not substitute direct private-state manipulation for native input evidence.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Native swipe down opens Settings from the dashboard; swipe up returns editor → preset selection → Settings → dashboard exactly one level. Up from any preset editor/input/error view discards the complete draft as Cancel and leaves saved configuration/revision unchanged. Right is no longer the back gesture along this path.
- [ ] Native left/right swipes advance/reverse Name, Pedal sensitivity, Dynamic assist and Pedal dip compensation, wrapping at both ends. The same behavior works during name/numeric entry; right cannot leave the editor and horizontal gestures cannot merely page alphabet characters.
- [ ] Keep all draft/input text and dip inclusion across field changes, including empty/unfinished percentages. Save from the current input gathers the whole editor; Cancel/up discards it. Character-page selection, case, spaces, digits, character clearing and backspace remain usable without taking over field gestures.
- [ ] Save/Cancel stay visible and meaningful within 240×240, with understandable validation/retry feedback and gesture prompts. Editor Back, Save slot, preset Clear and separate Set/Done remain absent/inactive. Native swipe recognition must not also dispatch a tap against old control coordinates or navigate two levels.
- [ ] Preserve independent alert editing while updating shared Settings back gestures consistently. Preserve riding preset menu entry/return and immediate application, eligibility and serialized controls, wake/button/horn behavior, dashboard/alert timing and prolonged-hold recovery.
- [ ] Navigation and draft exit write no configuration and emit zero wheel-setting packets. Only successful whole-editor Save persists; only the riding preset menu applies a saved definition. Disconnect/reconnect and incoming readings cannot discard keypad input or reinterpret local gestures as wheel operations.

## Tests and evidence

- Replay the laptop navigation ticket's exact action/gesture/frame scenarios through production main, CST816 touch interrupt decoding, controls, Graphics, native Storage and transport in the existing offline runtime. Use independent expected screen/page/draft/saved/packet results, with only physical inputs, BLE, flash and time controlled.
- Test the complete hierarchy return, both wraps, all four fields/slots, open name/numeric keypads, empty/unfinished values, validation/save-failure views, multi-field Save and up/Cancel exits. Observe actual rendered controls and compare saved definitions after restart.
- Capture native touch events and rendered outputs proving gestures do not become taps, per-field completion, alphabet paging or Clear. Assert unchanged Storage/revision and zero setting packets until an explicit Save or separate riding-menu application as appropriate.
- Keep focused public-application, native runtime, navigation, alert and control regressions green. Record exact inputs, expected/observed results, Graphics output, Storage effects, outgoing packets and source hashes with simulated-hardware provenance. Actual touch calibration, physical rendering and memory fit remain under device acceptance.

## Blocked by

- https://github.com/EvgenyHitexis/EucWatch/issues/47 — supplies native local drafts, whole-editor Save/Cancel, validated Storage commits and revised control targets.
- https://github.com/EvgenyHitexis/EucWatch/issues/48 — supplies the completed laptop gesture interaction and reusable pointer/input scenarios this native route must match.
title: Implement matching watch preset swipe navigation
